description: A Late Iron Age and Roman nucleated settlement, with a phase as a fort between. Dating uncertain as site is only known from finds and crop marks, but several objects have been considered votive, so it is thought some kind of shrine may be present.
bibliography: Allen, Martyn, Tom Brindle, Alex Smith, Julian D Richards, Tim Evans, Neil Holbrook, Michael Fulford, and Nathan Blick. “The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: An Online Resource.” Archaeology Data Service, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
Jones, D, and J. B. Whitwell. “Survey of the Roman Fort and Multi-Period Settlement Complex at Kirmington on the Lincolnshire Wolds: A Non-Destructive Approach.” Lincolnshire Hist Archaeol 26 (1991).
Leahy, Kevin. “Votive Models from Kirmington, South Humberside.” Britannia 11 (1980): 326. https://doi.org/10.2307/525691.
